verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents self-serve, pay-as-you-go per-token billing with no minimums, contracts or hidden fees, and refers to each model's 'standard per-token price'. This implies per-model token rates exist without a sales conversation. The pack never shows a public pricing page or price list, so it is unproven that prices are published for every hosted model. Missing for 10: evidence of a public per-model pricing page or listing, confirmation that every hosted model's price is published, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: You only pay per token — no idle GPU time, no minimums, no seat fees.
Flex inference is billed at a 20% discount off the model's standard per-token price.
Low pay-as-you-go pricing - no long-term contracts, no hidden fees, no surprises.
